# Pi Mobile — source map for code agents

Read AGENTS.md and the active goal loop-develop/current-todo/001-todo.md before changing code. This repository is a mobile window onto the SAME running Pi in Orca; tests must not reload/interrupt it or send paid prompts. During the migration: do not publish an APK, push, deploy or send Telegram before Billy reviews the work.

Product/release state: README.md (v0.6.003 shipped; migration is local WIP). Truthful architecture map: docs/architecture.md. Exact current class ownership: architecture/owners.json; feature passports: architecture/capsules/README.md. Visual references: docs/ui-baseline/README.md and immutable PNGs/manifest.json. Wire semantics/security: docs/protocol.md, docs/setup.md; release checks: docs/verification.md.

Android (android/app/src/main/java/ru/billyhargrove/pimobile): PiApp app shell; MainActivity catalog/settings/history (Java/XML); ChatActivity messages/composer (Java/XML); OrchestrationActivity.kt workflows/agents (Kotlin/Compose cards/header/transcript and tool groups, public read-only ui/PiTranscript contract; Markwon TextView leaf for tables/LaTeX). core/ owns DTO/parsers/command and transcript logic, including one TranscriptPresentation policy for legacy and Compose renderers; ui/PiTheme uses the existing neutral resource palette; net/ owns HTTP/WSS/attachments transport; store/ owns private settings/cache/token; media/ owns image preparation; ui/ contains legacy View components being migrated one at a time. Kotlin/Compose migration coexists with Java/XML temporarily; never keep two permanent feature implementations. Read relevant tests under android/app/src/test/ and android/app/src/androidTest/ before editing a screen.

Host: server/gateway.mjs is composition root for HTTP/WS/Unix bridge; server/command-policy.mjs validates bounded commands, server/message-projection.mjs sanitizes transcript rows, server/media-cache.mjs bounds image bytes, server/session-projection.mjs sanitizes public configuration and snapshot frames; server/orchestration.mjs owns bounded read-only workflow/agent storage; extension/mobile.ts interfaces with Pi; contracts/agent-transcript.mjs contains pure transcript projection shared between server and extension. Neither runtime imports the other's implementation. Do not alter live gateway or Pi processes for validation.

Gates: npm run quality (Node tests, ownership/import boundaries, screenshot hashes), then android/gradlew testDebugUnitTest assembleDebug assembleDebugAndroidTest with JDK17 and API35 SDK. ADB Android UI tests do not dispatch prompts. Build locally only; no release until approved. Architecture guards must grow with ownership changes, not be bypassed.
